title: GPT-4V(ision) as A Social Media Analysis Engine

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to infer gender from multimodal social media posts and analyzing its reliance on traditional gender roles and stereotypes versus its recognition of diverse gender expressions.
Classifying the political ideology (Left, Center, Right) of multimodal social media posts and assessing the model's comprehension of political rhetoric, domain knowledge, and visual subtleties.

Testing the model's zero-shot performance on hate speech detection datasets (e.g., HatefulMemes) and analyzing its ability to identify implicit racism, racial slurs, and intentional misspellings in multimodal content.
Evaluating hate speech detection capabilities on multimodal posts (such as those from 4chan's /pol/ board) to identify antisemitic and Islamophobic content, tropes, and derogatory language.
Assessing the model's contextual awareness in identifying offensive slang and hate speech targeting the LGBTQ+ community within image-text pairs.
Analyzing the model's capacity to recognize derogatory terms and slangs used offensively against people with disabilities in multimodal contexts.
Qualitatively assessing the model's understanding of non-Western cultural nuances, internet memes, and slang, highlighting limitations stemming from its predominantly English-centric training.
Evaluating the model's performance on multilingual social multimedia content (e.g., Chinese, Japanese, Korean), noting its difficulties in recognizing non-English OCR and context.
